description: Implementation of LoanAccountOwnerTransferService handling transfer lifecycle events such as canceling, declining, and executing buyback transfers for loans, including business event notifications and transfer detail management.

classes.name: LoanAccountOwnerTransferServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class managing external asset owner transfers related to loan accounts, including canceling, declining, and executing buyback transfers, with event notifications.

methods.name: handleLoanClosedOrOverpaid
methods.description: Main method to handle transfer logic when a loan is closed or overpaid, deciding whether to cancel, decline, or execute buyback transfers based on current transfer statuses.

methods.name: cancelTransfer
methods.description: Cancels a pending transfer and notifies via business event.

methods.name: declineTransfer
methods.description: Declines a transfer and notifies via business event.

methods.name: executePendingBuybackTransfer
methods.description: Executes a buyback transfer, updates transfer details, deletes mapping, posts journal entries, and notifies events.

methods.name: createCancelledTransfer
methods.description: Creates and saves a cancelled transfer record with status CANCELLED.

methods.name: createDeclinedTransfer
methods.description: Creates and saves a declined transfer record with status DECLINED and appropriate substatus.

methods.name: updatePendingTransfer
methods.description: Updates the effective date of a pending transfer.

methods.name: updatePendingBuybackTransfer
methods.description: Updates a buyback transfer with new details and effective date.

methods.name: updateActiveTransfer
methods.description: Updates an active transfer's effective date.

methods.name: createAssetOwnerTransferDetails
methods.description: Creates transfer details including outstanding interest and other financial info.

methods.name: findActiveOrActiveIntermediateTransfer
methods.description: Finds an active or intermediate transfer for a given loan and owner.

methods.name: findAllPendingOrBuybackOrIntermediateTransfers
methods.description: Retrieves all pending, buyback, or intermediate transfers for a loan.

methods.name: isBiggerThanZero
methods.description: Checks if a BigDecimal value is greater than zero.

methods.name: isSameDayTransfers
methods.description: Determines if all transfers in the list have the same settlement date.
